as_told.title: Sarbacher and Oppenheimer started the UFO clearance system

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer turned whistleblower, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the wartime effort to build the atomic bomb, created the secrecy category that also covered UFO material, and he linked this to a scientist named Robert Sarbacher. Michels later repeated it a little differently, saying Oppenheimer helped set up the original UFO secrecy rules with the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that ran nuclear matters after the war. If true, UFO secrecy would date back to the very birth of nuclear secrecy in the 1940s and 50s.
